title: Martin NDE 6962
content: I started the night with severe back pain that seemed to be spams, but I could not tell. At that time, we had home medical care. They diagnosed muscular pains and I was to rest. Within two days, the pains were unbearable and I was rejecting all types of foods. On the third day, I was even rejecting water. My mother took me to a doctor from social services and I was admitted to a hospital. There, they did an analysis and according to them, it was ‘renal colic’, and they released me. A week later, I again had difficulties with my health and they took me to another doctor that realized what I really had. I was hospitalized and I had to have surgery. After they operated on my kidney, the results were not as expected and they had to open me up again after a month and a half. After the second surgery, I became anemic from the lost blood, but according to the analysis, I was doing okay. This, despite feeling weak. I also remember passing out and fainting. After 15 days, I am released to continue the treatment and to recover at home. One of those nights, I got up, went past my mother's room to go to the bathroom. When I was returning to my bedroom, I felt dizzy and I fainted. Waiting to wake up again, I felt as if I was rising up, with dark all around me. All of a sudden, all turns gray. It is as if the entire place was covered with fog. Wherever I looked, it was the same. I remember that I was not scared, only disconcerted. Yet, I felt an immense peace and serenity. That's all I was feeling. I did not feel the weight of my body although I was the one there. Suddenly in the fog, I could see a lighter little dot in front of me and it attracted me. At that moment, I decided to advance; I hear a masculine voice over my right shoulder that tells me ‘Not yet’ and touches my shoulder. When I tried to turn, I felt as if I was falling. All of a sudden, I woke up sitting on a chair in my mother's room, with my mother crying and hugging me. Instinctively, the first thing I did was to throw my head back trying to breathe as if it had been long time without my breathing and cold sweat started to run. When the medical service arrived, I was diagnosed with a sudden drop in my blood pressure. After this, we never called this medical service of this company again.

arrival.other_being_detail: A masculine voice over the right shoulder said, 'Not yet,' and touched his shoulder.

environment.environment_other_detail: Darkness turning gray, as if everything was covered with fog.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Post-surgery anemia/weakness with fainting; later diagnosed as sudden drop in blood pressure after the episode.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Darkness/gray fog with a lighter dot ahead; a masculine voice said 'Not yet' and touched his shoulder, followed by a sensation of falling and awakening.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Fainted, then experienced rising into darkness/gray fog with a light dot; heard a voice saying 'Not yet' and felt falling; then awoke in his mother's room.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He awoke sitting on a chair in his mother's room rather than where he fainted (returning from bathroom to bedroom).
